sky.description: The colour at the top of the sky

glow.description: The colour of the sky at the horizon

sun.description: The colour of the sun and its reflection

main.description: Paint a small sunset over the sea and export it: a quick proof that the skill works, about a minute

steps.text: A sunset over the sea, painted with the krita-painting skill.

setup.description: Install Krita 5.0.2 if needed, start it with a 900x1200 canvas, maximize it and set the view to 42% so the canvas matches the frame

steps.text: Getting Krita ready: a 900 by 1200 canvas.

cmd: command -v krita >/dev/null || sudo bash -c 'apt-get update -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=120 >/tmp/krita-install.log 2>&1 && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=120 --no-install-recommends krita krita-data >>/tmp/krita-install.log 2>&1'; command -v krita
pgrep -x krita >/dev/null || (nohup env QT_ACCESSIBILITY=1 QT_LINUX_ACCESSIBILITY_ALWAYS_ON=1 krita --nosplash --new-image RGBA,U8,900,1200 >/tmp/krita.log 2>&1 &); echo started

view.description: Maximize Krita, fit the page, then zoom to 42%: the canvas then sits at the frame's origin with a margin, and the brush tool is active

color.description: Set the foreground colour (what fills, strokes and the gradient use) through the colour dialog's hex field

brush.description: Pick a brush preset by name and set its size in canvas pixels (also selects the brush tool; a preset brings its own opacity)

preset.description: Airbrush (soft shading, haze), Basic-1 (round, hard), Pencil-2, Fineliner, Gpen (ink), Bristles-1 (fine bristles), Bristles-2 (flat, rough), Bristles-3 (large, smooth), Wet Paint, Watercolor Texture, Chalk Soft, Stamp Grass, Stamp Leaves, Stylised Tree, Starfield

size.description: Brush size in canvas pixels, 1 to 1000
Change the brush size, in canvas pixels (about 3 seconds: plan few size changes)

opacity.description: Change the brush opacity, 1 to 100 percent (picking a preset resets it)

fill.description: Fill a shape with the foreground colour: lasso its outline (canvas pixels, closed for you), fill, deselect, back to the brush tool

path.description: The outline in canvas pixels, at least 3 points

smooth.description: A smooth curve through the points (false: straight edges)

fill_canvas.description: Fill the whole canvas with the foreground colour

mask.description: Select a shape (canvas pixels) and keep it selected: the strokes after it only paint inside, until clear_mask or the next fill or mask

clear_mask.description: Drop the selection, so strokes paint anywhere again

stroke.description: Paint a stroke along a path in canvas pixels with the current brush, colour, size and opacity: a smooth line through the points, sampled every few pixels (two points give a straight line)

path.description: At least 2 points in canvas pixels

dab.description: One touch of the brush at a point in canvas pixels (an eye's pupil, a star, a highlight)

gradient.description: A linear gradient from the foreground colour at from to transparent at to, over what is painted (inside the mask when there is one)

undo.description: Take back the last step in Krita's history (a deselect is a step of its own: a fill takes three undos, a stroke after a fill one)

export.description: Export the painting as a 900x1200 PNG into /home/capsulate/Pictures (an older file of that name is replaced)

checks.name: The canvas sits where the frame says
checks.description: A new canvas is white inside the frame and Krita's grey around it

checks.name: A fill and a stroke land where they should
main paints a sunset and exports it

traps.title: A lasso pressed inside the current selection moves that selection
traps.detail: Krita treats a press inside a selection as a move: while painting the Mona Lisa, the river's lasso dragged the hills' selection and the fill flooded the hills.
traps.fix: fill and mask deselect (Ctrl+Shift+A) before every lasso, so each outline starts a new selection.

traps.title: The view scrolls when a drag nears the window's edge
traps.detail: A curve that overshot and a lasso along the canvas's bottom row both made Krita scroll the view; every coordinate after that landed shifted.
traps.fix: The view sits at 42% with a margin around the canvas, and the canvas frame clamps every point (smooth curves are sampled first, then clamped).

traps.title: Deselect from the Select menu is greyed out with nothing selected, and keeps the menu open
traps.detail: The open menu then swallows the next click.
traps.fix: Deselect with the keyboard (Ctrl+Shift+A): harmless when nothing is selected.

traps.title: The colour dialog opens in a different place each time
traps.fix: color moves it to a fixed spot before typing the hex value.

traps.title: Painting with a selection only paints inside it
traps.detail: After a lasso fill, the next strokes were confined to the filled shape.
traps.fix: fill ends with a deselect; mask keeps its selection on purpose until clear_mask.

traps.title: The gradient goes from the foreground colour to transparent, not to the background colour
traps.fix: Fill the canvas with the far colour first (fill_canvas), then lay the gradient over it.

traps.title: A stroke given as bare points paints only where the pointer stops
traps.detail: Krita's brush paints along the pointer's motion: a two-point stroke sent as two points left small marks instead of a line.
traps.fix: stroke always samples a smooth line through the points, every few pixels.

traps.title: A fill sent right after the lasso does nothing
traps.detail: Krita builds the lasso selection a moment after the mouse is released: 5 of 6 fills sent 100 ms after the release found no selection and painted nothing; at 250 ms, 6 of 6 filled.
traps.fix: fill and mask wait 300 ms after the lasso before the selection is used.

traps.title: Each size or opacity change takes about 3 seconds
traps.detail: The value is set through the accessibility tree.
traps.fix: Group the strokes by brush and size, and change them rarely.
